digest.component_or_area: rebar doctor command — lock health checks
propositions: rebar doctor lacks observability into lock hold state; operators cannot see who holds a lock or whether the holder is alive without manual filesystem inspection

The doctor command must report four lock legs (tickets-write fcntl, tickets-write mkdir, hlc, enrich-drain) with held/free/absent status and decode v2 ownership stamps to surface holder identity, liveness, and hold age
Stale lock detection must be delegated exclusively to the existing lock_owner._mkdir_lock_is_stale function; no independent staleness heuristic is introduced
Only stale locks produce findings and cause exit code 1; held locks with live holders are reported as INFO and do not affect exit code
Doctor operations are read-only; no lock state is reclaimed, modified or deleted during scanning or repair
